category: Channel-reply continuation / wind measures / grammatical agents

category: Training ordinary mind / interposed relation / nonduality of times
problem: The opening alternates objects, body, the interval and speech before supreme training of ordinary mind. las kyi bya, mixing the nonduality of times, and the absence of reason-examination are compressed. The source explicitly negates examination in the final clause.
treatment: Preserve each training field and the repeated ordinary-mind wording, keeping the nonduality-of-times phrase provisional. Retain the final negative rather than turn it into an instruction to investigate reasons. Do not invent breath timing, posture or intermediate anatomy.
uncertainty: The speech clause, time/nonduality relation and the grammatical scope of the last negative require review.
action: Read the entire training sequence with the corresponding question and distinguish source wording from any later practice explanation.

category: Afflictions / 120 count / two ordinary minds / all-basis realization
problem: The source compares affliction to fear of one's own shadow, gives 120 without a measurement interval, and mentions two ordinary minds arising from two truths without naming them. It says the all-basis is realized as the great dharma embodiment, after previously distinguishing them.
treatment: Preserve all counts and contrasts, the neutrality phrase, and the explicit all-basis/dharma-embodiment realization statement. Do not harmonize this into either permanent identity or absolute separation; retain its stated context.
uncertainty: The two ordinary minds, the agency of seeing one's own intrinsic nature and the relation between count and affliction remain unresolved.
action: Review the two all-basis passages together and resolve the local syntax without overwriting either source statement.

category: Aggregates and embodiments / bubble eyes / affirmative delusion / rhetorical questions
problem: The source asks who has not known or seen the stated identities, calls the eyes chu bur, and explicitly says delusive appearance arises from the lamps' crucial point. It identifies all conceptual thoughts with meditative stabilization in a rhetorical question and later says there is nothing to train or place.
treatment: Preserve the questions, bubble-like eye description, affirmative delusion wording and all strong identity and nontraining statements. Keep meditative stabilization distinct from deep absorption and ordinary mind distinct from primordial knowing. Do not turn these into editorial assertions or practical permission to omit training.
uncertainty: The eye metaphor, the scope of the five-buddha identity and the apparent tensions with earlier training instructions require review.
action: Interpret only after reviewing the whole concluding reply; retain the source's assertions without substituting a conciliatory paraphrase.

category: Universal-buddhahood rhetoric / ambiguous double predicate / life-stage correspondences
problem: U03591 has two negative predicates without an explicit connective, allowing more than one relation between not-buddha and not-sentient-being. The passage associates birth, gestation, embodiment, aging, illness and death with doctrinal categories. cer mthong is a related naked-seeing form.
treatment: Keep U03591 visibly unresolved rather than force a logical implication or a neither/nor interpretation. Preserve every life-stage correspondence and render nyams su myong through the established experiential-acquaintance expression. Retain the source's universal-buddhahood statements as translated teaching, not independently established facts.
uncertainty: The U03591 logic, naked-seeing usage, same-phenomena relation and several life-stage predicates need review.
action: Resolve the ambiguous connective from the complete argument and authorized commentary; do not treat the illness/death correspondences as medical claims.

uncertainty: The exact force of unbinding and gdar sha chod and the title's modifier attachment remain provisional.
action: Approve the title and settlement expression after comparison with the remaining chapter colophons; the completed chapter remains a translator-reviewed draft, not independent QC.

category: Third-chapter opening / title-versus-name / complete question list / uncontrived speech

action: Review the opening with the third-chapter colophon and first reply, documenting an alternative name reading separately if supported.

category: Abiding times / lunar-number ellipsis / scan variant / wind counts

The print separates sbyar yang byung from main sbyang at U03673. Five hundred and thousand-junctures occur without an explicit modern unit.
treatment: Preserve all times and counts, propose fourteenth and bracketed fifteenth through shared tens, and retain half of twelve parts without calculating it. Keep train as the main reading and report apply separately. Do not infer minutes, a breathing rate, lifespan prediction or a working calendar.
uncertainty: The lunar ellipsis, the part/half hierarchy, the thousand-juncture sense and the classification of the ten subdivisions require review.
action: Review the numbers and their units from the selected source before any calculation; preserve all alternatives and the absence of practical specifications.

action: Review the complete first reply and its announced subdivisions without reconstructing a breath or body practice.

category: Eight aspects of delusion / phri query / names and categories

category: Nine points / causes and conditions / contamination / apprehended-object negation
problem: The cause/condition lists and the clauses concerning limits are nominal and do not fully specify their grouping. The Ground is described as nondifferentiating and indeterminate; knowing engages, vanishes and holds. The last phrase concerns binding as true even where there is no apprehended object.
treatment: Preserve the Ground, knowing, contamination, apprehended object and faculties as distinct. Bracket the implied holding-as-true construction without turning gzung ba into a verb or adding a subject. Leave the grouping of the announced nine points open for the continuation.
uncertainty: The cause/condition boundaries, limit agents, the scope of contamination and the final binding predicate require review.
action: Read the complete reply beyond U03750 and reconcile the nine headings only through explicit textual evidence.
